novawebhook-desc: The description used for the Discord extension
novawebhook-talk:
Short for "talk".

Used as the text for $2 in {{msg-mw|novawebhook-userlinks}}
novawebhook-contribs:
Short for "contributions".

Used as the text for $3 in {{msg-mw|novawebhook-userlinks}}
novawebhook-diff: Used as the text for $1 in novawebhook-revisionlinks
novawebhook-minor:
Short for "minor edit". The letter should be the same as in {{msg-mw|Minoreditletter}}.

Used as the text for $2 in {{msg-mw|novawebhook-revisionlinks}}.
novawebhook-edit:
Message sent to Discord for when a page edit is made. Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - Page link
* $3 - novawebhook-revisionlinks
* $4 - Summary (always surrounded in tildes)
novawebhook-create:
Message sent to Discord for when a page creation is made. Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - Page link
* $3 - novawebhook-revisionlinks
* $4 - Summary (always surrounded in tildes)
novawebhook-articledelete:
Message sent to Discord when a page is deleted. Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - Page link
* $3 - Reason (always surrounded in tildes)
* $4 - Number of revisions deleted
novawebhook-undeleterev: Used as the text for $2 in novawebhook-articleundelete if revisions are being undeleted rather than a page
novawebhook-articleundelete:
Message sent to Discord when pages/revisions are undeleted.
Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - novawebhook-undeleterev
* $3 - Page link
* $4 - Comment (always surrounded in tildes)
novawebhook-revvisibility:
Message sent to Discord when the visibility of revisions is changed.
Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - Number of revisions
* $3 - Page link
novawebhook-articleprotect:
Message sent to Discord when an article's protection is changed.
Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - Page link
* $3 - Reason (always surrounded in tildes)
* $4 - Protection settings
novawebhook-titlemove:
Message sent to Discord when an article is moved. Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - Old page link
* $3 - New page link
* $4 - Reason (always surrounded in tildes)
* $5 - novawebhook-revisionlinks
novawebhook-localusercreated:
Message sent to Discord when a user registers.
Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
novawebhook-blockipcomplete:
Message sent to Discord when a user is blocked. Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks (performer)
* $2 - novawebhook-userlinks (target)
* $3 - Reason (always surrounded in tildes)
* $4 - Expiry text (using novawebhook-blocktimeformat)
novawebhook-unblockusercomplete:
Message sent to Discord when a user is unblocked. Parameters:
$1 - novawebhook-userlinks (performer)
$2 - novawebhook-userlinks (target)
novawebhook-usergroupschanged:
Message sent to Discord when a user's group is changed. Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks (performer)
* $2 - novawebhook-userlinks (target)
* $3 - Reason (always surrounded in tildes)
* $4 - Added rights (prepended by +)
* $5 - Removed rights (prepended by -)
novawebhook-uploadnewver: Used as the text for $2 in novawebhook-uploadcomplete
novawebhook-uploadcomplete:
Message sent to Discord when an upload is made. Parameters:

* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - novawebhook-uploadnewver
* $3 - File link
* $4 - Comment (always surrounded in tildes)
* $5 - Size (formatted as KB/MB/GB)
* $6 - File width
* $7 - File height
* $8 - File MIME type
novawebhook-filedeletecomplete:
Message sent to Discord when a file version is deleted (not an entire file).
Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - File link
* $3 - Comment (always surrounded in tildes)
novawebhook-fileundeletecomplete:
Message sent to Discord when a file version is restored (not an entire file).
Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - File link
* $3 - Comment (always surrounded in tildes)
novawebhook-afterimportpage:
Message sent to Discord when a page is imported. Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - Page link
* $3 - Number of revisions in XML file
* $4 - Number of revisions successfully imported
novawebhook-timestampformat:
{{optional}}

Timestamp format using Discord's dynamic timestamp syntax. Discord will automatically render this in each user's local timezone for accurate event timing. It should not need to be localized.
Parameters:

* $1 - Unix timestamp in UTC
novawebhook-articlemergecomplete:
Message sent to Discord when page histories are merged. Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks
* $2 - Target link
* $3 - Destination link
novawebhook-renameusercomplete:
Message sent to Discord when a user is renamed (Renameuser extension).
Parameters:
* $1 - novawebhook-userlinks (admin user)
* $2 - Old username
* $3 - New username link
